_meta.description: Hand-off contract for Backend (Member 1) to import into FastAPI agent loop.

function.name: recall_similar_incidents
function.description: Query past resolved incidents matching service name and symptom patterns from Hindsight vector/episodic memory.

service_name.description: Name of the affected service or infrastructure component (e.g., 'checkout-api', 'payments-db').
service_name.title: Service Name

symptom.description: Primary symptom, error pattern, or observed anomaly string (e.g., 'HTTP 500 spike post deploy').
symptom.title: Symptom

limit.description: Maximum number of historical similar incidents to recall from Hindsight episodic memory.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: recall_failed_fixes
function.description: Retrieve negative-memory records of known failed remediations, anti-patterns, or harmful actions attempted for this incident signature to prevent repeating past mistakes.

service_name.description: Name of the affected service or infrastructure component.
service_name.title: Service Name

incident_signature.description: Error signature, stack trace fingerprint, or incident pattern used to query negative memory for failed remediation attempts.
incident_signature.title: Incident Signature

function.name: get_recent_deploys
function.description: Fetch deployment history, commit hashes, authors, and rollout status for a service within a given lookback window.

service_name.description: Target service name to query deployment history.
service_name.title: Service Name

lookback_hours.description: Hours to look back for recent deployments, canary rollouts, or config updates.
lookback_hours.title: Lookback Hours

function.name: get_logs
function.description: Retrieve recent log events and error traces for a specific service and incident.

service_name.description: Service identifier whose logs need to be fetched.
service_name.title: Service Name

incident_id.description: Identifier of the active incident for correlated log querying (e.g., 'INC-2045').
incident_id.title: Incident Id

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to retrieve.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: get_service_owner
function.description: Find the primary on-call engineer, team lead, and escalation contact details for a given service.

service_name.description: Name of the service to look up on-call engineers, squad lead, and escalation pathways.
service_name.title: Service Name

function.name: post_to_band_room
function.description: Broadcast real-time triage updates, incident status, hypotheses, or escalation alerts to the virtual incident command/band room.

incident_id.description: Target incident war room / band room identifier.
incident_id.title: Incident Id

message.description: Markdown-formatted message or structured update to post to the incident channel.
message.title: Message

sender.description: Display name or system identity of the entity posting to the room.
sender.title: Sender

agent_response_schema.description:
Structured final response schema produced by the RecallOps SRE agent
upon completing incident triage, investigation, and root-cause synthesis.

failed_fixes_warning: Do NOT restart payments-db: failed 2x in Sept and caused cascade outage
Do NOT increase thread pool beyond 200 without buffer pool resizing
example.hypothesis: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by unindexed query introduced in release v2.4.1.
example.recommended_action: Rollback payments-service to release v2.4.0 and apply hotfix index on orders.customer_id.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier of the incident being triaged (e.g., 'INC-2045').
incident_id.title: Incident Id

hypothesis.description: Root cause hypothesis derived from symptoms, logs, deploys, and recalled historical incidents.
hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 representing certainty of the diagnosis and recommendation.
confidence.title: Confidence

cited_incident_ids.description: List of historical incident IDs referenced as precedent or evidence (e.g., ['INC-1987']).
cited_incident_ids.title: Cited Incident Ids

failed_fixes_warning.description: Critical warnings of remediation attempts that failed in past incidents and MUST NOT be repeated (negative memory).
failed_fixes_warning.title: Failed Fixes Warning

recommended_action.description: Actionable, prescriptive recommendation for resolving or mitigating the incident.
recommended_action.title: Recommended Action

likely_owner.description: Team, squad, or on-call engineer identified as the appropriate owner/resolver.
likely_owner.title: Likely Owner

agent_response_schema.title: AgentTriageResponse
